panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: All four numbered stages remain. labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: Candidate names remain FireRed-1.1, Qwen-Image-Edit, FLUX.2-dev, Seedream-5.0, Kling-Image-o1, GPT-Image-1.5, Nano-Banana-Pro, Nano-Banana-2, and GPT-Image-2. GGT-100K, 100K training pairs, and 500 test pairs are unchanged. No equations appear.

connections_and_direction.evidence: The stages retain their left-to-right ordering. All four LQ-to-candidate arrows point right; quality control proceeds downward through filtering, refinement, and verification. The iterative-refinement arrow still points left toward target generation. Evaluation bracketing and red downward dataset connectors remain.

visual_encodings.evidence: Blue source collection, pink evaluation, green target generation, purple quality control, and yellow dataset grouping remain consistent. Green before/after arrows, purple quality-control arrows, award markers for the selected pipeline, and numbered stage markers preserve their meanings.

examples_and_data.evidence: The house, tower, horse/cart photograph, and Chinese sign remain in the source and target examples. Training examples retain the building facade, monochrome text/wall, and street scenes; test examples retain branches, colored panels, and a car scene. The supplied pixel-equality evidence covers the complete original rectangle at scale 1 without exclusions, supporting preservation of these data-bearing visuals.

unsupported_additions.evidence: The added top banner summarizes collection → comparison of target generators → generation → quality verification, matching the original stages and caption. The bottom banner names metric filtering, VLM-assisted refinement, and human verification, all explicitly present in the original. Neither adds a new result, measurement, or method component.

complete_visible_content.evidence: The derivative full image contains all original content and both added banners without visible clipping or corrupted replacement text. Cropping at the edges of the supplied detail views does not occur in the full derivative.

remaining_limitations: Assessment uses the supplied images, caption, and reported pixel-equality evidence; the proof file was not independently opened. The added banners lie outside the preserved original rectangle and were checked semantically against the original. Retained source resolution and visual blemishes are independently scored; no quality-informed reroll.

Figure 3: Overview of the GGT-100K construction pipeline. We collect diverse real-world LQ images,
evaluate MFMs for HQ target generation, and apply multi-stage quality control to build the dataset.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed final full four-stage data-construction diagram and read caption/checks. All nine candidate model labels, four prompts and criteria, original image pairs, Chinese signs, 100K/500 counts and iterative leftward feedback remain intact. New top and bottom banners summarize existing collection/comparison/generation/QC and filtering/refining/verifying; source scientific rectangle independently replayed native.
